source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension (នាយកដ្ឋានផ្សព្វផ្សាយកសិកម្ម), "ដំណាំសណ្តែកដី" (Peanut / Groundnut Cultivation handbook), Kingdom of Cambodia, 2008, produced under Loan 2022-CAM(SF) (an ADB-financed project; the cover names a livelihood/agriculture-improvement program under this loan). Uploaded as a 14-page scanned PDF; no embedded text layer, all content read visually from page images. This is Source B for crop/peanut in this knowledge base (Source A was a shorter ECOSORN leaflet processed in Batch 42).
text: Pods intended for seed should be shelled carefully by hand or by a gentle beating method to avoid damaging the seed coat, and shelling should be timed close to planting (the source specifies roughly 6-8 hours before sowing) to preserve germination. Where seed-rot/damping-off risk is a concern, the source recommends a fungicide seed treatment before planting. For planting spacing, the source gives figures such as roughly 3 x 2 and roughly 4 x 1.5 for the spacing ratio between planting configurations (one seed per hole vs. two seeds per hole), but the unit of measurement printed for these figures could not be confirmed with confidence from the scanned source (see caveat). After sowing, holes are covered evenly with soil; germination begins around 4-5 days after planting, and the source states germination is generally complete by roughly 25-30 days after planting.
caveat: Planting-spacing unit not confirmed: the source prints a Khmer word transcribed here as resembling 'តីក' immediately after each spacing number (e.g. '3 [unit] x 2 [unit]', '4 [unit] x 1.5 [unit]'), and this could not be matched with confidence to a standard Khmer unit of length (meters and centimeters are the units normally used in this knowledge base's other cultivation sources). It may denote feet, a transliteration artifact, or a scan/OCR legibility issue. The numeric ratios (3:2 and 4:1.5) are reported as printed, but the reader should not assume these are meters without independent confirmation; a future session with a clearer re-scan of this passage could resolve the unit.
